stories.title: Advogado do Master encaminhou a Vorcaro foto de Gonet fumando charuto em Londres

en.title: Master's lawyer sent Vorcaro a photo of Gonet smoking a cigar in London
en.summary: A lawyer representing Master bank's interests forwarded to Vorcaro a photograph showing Gonet smoking a cigar in London.

stories.title: Conversas extraídas do celular de Vorcaro mostram Gonet e ex-banqueiro em noite de charutos e uísque em Londres

en.title: Conversations extracted from Vorcaro's phone show Gonet and former banker in night of cigars and whiskey in London
en.summary: Mobile phone messages between Vorcaro and lawyer Ciro Soares contain a photograph of Brazil's attorney general Paulo Gonet drinking whiskey and smoking cigars with the Master Bank owner.

stories.title: Festival de Verão de Salvador 2027 terá encontro inédito da Timbalada com o Olodum

en.title: Salvador Summer Festival 2027 will feature unprecedented meeting of Timbalada with Olodum
en.summary: The 2027 Salvador Summer Festival will include performances by Maria Bethânia, a collaboration of Alceu Valença with Elba Ramalho and Geraldo Azevedo, and a first-time meeting of Timbalada with Olodum.

stories.title: Trump se reunirá com Delcy Rodríguez, presidente da Venezuela, na ONU

en.title: Trump will meet with Delcy Rodríguez, president of Venezuela, at the UN
en.summary: Trump is scheduled to meet with Venezuela's president Delcy Rodríguez at the United Nations.

stories.title: Milton Leite diz ser inocente após se entregar: ‘Só se arrepende quem comete crime’

en.title: Milton Leite says he is innocent after turning himself in: 'Only those who commit crimes repent'
en.summary: Milton Leite turned himself in to authorities and proclaimed his innocence, suggesting that only guilty parties would express remorse.

stories.title: Trump vai se encontrar com Delcy Rodríguez em NY, onde Maduro está preso

en.title: Trump will meet with Delcy Rodríguez in NY, where Maduro is imprisoned
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump is scheduled to meet with Venezuela's interim leader Delcy Rodríguez in New York during next week's UN General Assembly, as deposed dictator Nicolás Maduro remains imprisoned in the city awaiting trial.

stories.title: Cury e Zema focam debate em críticas ao STF e a reajuste do Bolsa Família às vésperas da eleição

en.title: Cury and Zema focus debate on criticism of STF and Bolsa Família increase ahead of election
en.summary: Two candidates center their election debate on attacking the Brazilian Supreme Court and discussing adjustments to the Bolsa Família welfare program.

stories.title: 1ª Turma do STF tem maioria para manter condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro em caso de coação

en.title: STF's First Panel has majority to uphold Eduardo Bolsonaro's conviction in coercion case
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court First Panel voted to reject former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro's appeal, sustaining his conviction for coercion related to intimidating the Brazilian judiciary from the United States.

stories.title: Primeira Turma do STF rejeita recurso e mantém condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por coação

en.title: Supreme Court's First Panel Rejects Appeal and Upholds Eduardo Bolsonaro's Coercion Conviction
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court rejected an appeal from former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro, maintaining his conviction related to coercion charges.

stories.title: Primeira Turma do STF mantém condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro

en.title: Supreme Court's First Panel Upholds Eduardo Bolsonaro's Conviction
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court First Panel unanimously rejected former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro's appeal against a sentence of four years and two months of imprisonment in a tariff-related case.

stories.title: Gilmar Mendes valida reajuste do Bolsa Família

en.title: Gilmar Mendes Validates Bolsa Família Adjustment
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes recognized the validity of a decree allowing for increases to Brazil's Bolsa Família program benefits, determining the adjustment does not violate electoral rules.

stories.title: PF acha foto de Gonet fumando charuto ao lado de Vorcaro em Londres

en.title: Federal Police Find Photo of Gonet Smoking Cigar Next to Vorcaro in London
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Police discovered a photograph on the phone of Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro showing him alongside Attorney General Paulo Gonet in London.

stories.title: 1ª Turma do STF tem maioria para manter condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro em caso de coação

en.title: Brazilian Supreme Court's First Panel Has Majority to Uphold Eduardo Bolsonaro's Conviction in Coercion Case
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court First Panel formed a majority to reject the appeal from former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro's defense, maintaining his conviction for coercion related to his actions in the United States.

stories.title: Análise: Países da Europa elevam nível de alerta contra 'guerra híbrida' da Rússia

en.title: Analysis: European Countries Raise Alert Level Against Russia's 'Hybrid Warfare'
en.summary: European governments, particularly France, have warned that Russia is intensifying psychological pressure on the region in recent weeks, despite the absence of clear military indicators of a large-scale NATO offensive.

stories.title: Advogado do Master encaminhou foto de Gonet com Vorcaro fumando charuto em Londres

en.title: Master Bank Lawyer Sent Photo of Gonet with Vorcaro Smoking Cigar in London
en.summary: Messages retrieved by federal police from Daniel Vorcaro's phone include a photograph of Brazil's attorney general Paulo Gonet at a gathering with the Master Bank owner in London, showing Gonet with a cigar.

stories.title: DF recorre à fala de Lula para cobrar no STF apoio federal ao BRB

en.title: DF appeals to Lula's statement to charge STF for federal support to BRB
en.summary: The Federal District government cited President Lula's statement that the federal government will not provide money to Brasília Bank to argue before Brazil's Supreme Court that the Union is resisting participation in a capital injection for the bank, which faces crisis following a banking scandal.
